children: Vistra entered into an Indenture to issue $1.5 billion of junior subordinated notes, providing long-term capital. The offering comprised $850 million of 7.000% Series A notes and $650 million of 7.250% Series B notes, each due in 2057 and guaranteed by Vistra. The notes were issued under an Indenture with Wilmington Trust as trustee, following an underwritten public offering. Management expects the issuance to enhance financial flexibility and support strategic initiatives.
